name: Hive 1.11.1
notes: Quieter, better-behaved agents. Agents no longer try to author a workflow during ordinary replies (a question, a code review, or a single edit isn't a workflow request) — they only do so when you explicitly ask for a pipeline or loop. When one is authored, the parser now tolerates a common near-miss (a trailing comma) instead of rejecting it, and if a suggested workflow still can't be added the note is calm and informational rather than an alarming warning. Patch on 1.11.0's per-workspace directories and per-chat worktrees.
